decisions.reason: A lever handle family builds directly on the firm's core expertise in metal handles, finishing and ergonomics, so it can interpret early results and refine the line rather than drop it after one year.
Mitred handles use the firm's proprietary engineering and finishing know-how, giving high absorptive fit and little reason to withdraw a recently launched design family.
A multifunctional lever extends the firm's ergonomic and barrier-free knowledge base, so management can assimilate feedback and improve it in-house.
This lever handle line sits squarely in the established product domain and fits the coordinated families, so keeping it is low-risk.
The award-winning 1289 collection has its own page and clear market validation, and it builds on core competencies, making it a flagship to keep.
A bronze patina finish draws on the firm's proprietary finishing expertise and broadens the coordinated range at low marginal cost.
